description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for Tiingo World News data, including query parameters, data validation, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: TiingoWorldNewsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Tiingo World News API requests, including date range, source, and pagination.

classes.name: TiingoWorldNewsData
classes.description: Represents individual news data entries fetched from Tiingo, with validation and aliasing.

classes.name: TiingoWorldNewsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, transformation, and validation from the Tiingo news API.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw news data from Tiingo API endpoints, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured TiingoWorldNewsData instances.
